verdict.rationale: Virtualization is a fair axis for an x86 processor, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. There is no mention of AMD-V/SVM, IOMMU, hypervisor support (KVM, Hyper-V, VMware) or Docker/container workflows. The listed OS support for Windows 11, RHEL and Ubuntu is adjacent and does not show that VMs or containers run well.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
